title: coelogyne lepantoensis
intro: Coelogyne lepantoensis, commonly known as the Lepanto Coelogyne, is a species of orchid native to the Philippines. This terrestrial orchid is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The Lepanto Coelogyne has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne lepantoensis have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
